question: Playing It My Way' is an autobiography of which of the following legendary cricket players?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sachin Tendulkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Playing It My Way** is the autobiography of cricket legend **Sachin Tendulkar**.
 
• The book was co-authored by **Boria Majumdar**, a well-known cricket historian.
 
• It was released on **5 November 2014**.
